# Presets

A preset is a named patch over the default parameters. Pick one with
`new Planet({ preset: 'desert' })` (the body type follows the preset) or
`planet.applyPreset('desert')`, then override anything:
`new Planet({ preset: 'desert', seed: 7, seaLevel: 0.2 })`. `listPresets()`
returns the names by type at runtime.
